title: hypericum richeri subsp. alpigenum
intro: Hypericum richeri subsp. alpigenum, commonly known as Alpine St. John's Wort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the St. John's Wort family (Hypericaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may help reduce anxiety and improve mood. The therapeutic actions of Alpine St. John's Wort are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including napthodianthrone derivatives and hyperforin, which have been shown to exhibit neuroprotective and adaptogenic properties. Additionally, Alpine St. John's Wort has been traditionally used to treat wounds, skin conditions, and gastrointestinal issues, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness for these purposes.
